description: Queries where context clearly answers the question - system should be CONFIDENT

cases.query: How does HTTPS encryption work?
contexts: HTTPS uses TLS encryption through a handshake process: First, the client sends supported cipher suites to the server. The server responds with its certificate and chosen cipher. The client verifies the certificate against trusted CAs, then both parties generate session keys using asymmetric encryption. All subsequent data is encrypted with these symmetric session keys.
cases.description: Technical mechanism question with full process explained
cases.rationale: The complete TLS handshake process is described step by step

cases.query: What is a microservice architecture?
contexts: Microservice architecture is a software design approach where an application is built as a collection of small, independent services. Each service runs in its own process, communicates via lightweight protocols (typically HTTP/REST), and can be deployed, updated, and scaled independently. This contrasts with monolithic architectures where all functionality exists in a single deployable unit.
cases.description: Architecture definition question with comprehensive explanation
cases.rationale: Complete definition with key characteristics and contrast provided

cases.query: How does the recommendation algorithm work?
contexts: Our recommendation algorithm uses a hybrid approach combining collaborative filtering and content-based methods. First, we build a user-item interaction matrix from viewing history. Collaborative filtering identifies users with similar preferences using cosine similarity. Content-based filtering analyzes item attributes (genre, actors, directors) using TF-IDF vectors. The final score combines both: 0.6 * collaborative_score + 0.4 * content_score, with a recency boost of 1.2x for items from the last 30 days.
cases.description: Complex algorithm question with full methodology explained
cases.rationale: Complete algorithm description with specific weights and methods

cases.query: How do I configure high availability for the database cluster?
contexts: High Availability Database Configuration: 1) Set up primary node with synchronous_commit=on. 2) Configure two standby nodes with streaming replication (max_wal_senders=5, wal_level=replica). 3) Install pgpool-II on separate server for connection pooling and failover. 4) Configure health checks (health_check_period=10, health_check_timeout=20). 5) Set up automatic failover (failover_command='/usr/local/bin/failover.sh %d %h'). 6) Configure virtual IP with keepalived for seamless client failover. 7) Test failover by stopping primary and verifying automatic promotion within 30 seconds.

cases.query: Why did the machine learning model's accuracy drop in production?
contexts: Root cause analysis identified data drift as the primary cause of the accuracy drop. Specifically: 1) Training data was from 2022-2023, but production data patterns shifted in Q1 2024 due to new product categories. 2) Feature distribution analysis showed the 'price' feature mean shifted from $45 to $78, outside the training distribution. 3) The 'category' feature had 12 new values not seen during training. Retraining with recent data restored accuracy from 76% to 94%.
cases.description: Technical causal question with detailed root cause analysis
cases.rationale: Specific cause (data drift) identified with quantified evidence

cases.query: How does the fraud detection system identify suspicious transactions?
contexts: The fraud detection system uses a multi-layer approach: Layer 1 applies rule-based filters (transactions over $10,000, international transfers to high-risk countries, velocity checks for 5+ transactions in 1 hour). Layer 2 uses an XGBoost model trained on 50 features including transaction amount, time, location, device fingerprint, and merchant category, achieving 99.2% recall at 0.1% false positive rate. Layer 3 employs graph analysis to detect coordinated fraud rings by analyzing transaction networks. Suspicious transactions are scored 0-100; scores above 75 trigger automatic holds, 50-75 require manual review.
cases.description: Complex system question with complete architecture explained
cases.rationale: Full three-layer system described with specific thresholds and methods
